title: Maple Syrup Cranberry Sauce
description: A Thanksgiving staple, this cranberry sauce recipe dresses up fresh cranberries with maple syrup, a splash of brandy, lemon juice, and brown sugar.

steps.text: Combine water and maple syrup in a saucepan; bring to a boil. Add cranberries; cook at a boil until berries pop, 10 to 15 minutes. Stir in brown sugar and lemon juice until sugar is completely dissolved. Stir in brandy.

video.description: Looking for a deliciously balanced and easy-to-make sauce for your holiday table? Look no further than this recipe, which simply calls for you to boil water and pure maple syrup together, then add a bag of fresh cranberries. Once the fruits have softened and released their juices, stir in brown sugar and lemon juice, and for an extra note of richness, a spoon of brandy. The results are a beautiful red fruit sauce for your table that’s delicious paired with poultry, especially turkey.
